summary: Iteration 13 - Verified new Shop Sale module (/shop-sale) end-to-end. Backend: 56/56 pytest passing (added 12 new tests in test_shop_sale.py). Frontend: rail-shop opens /shop-sale with tab-shop-sale active, column order matches spec (SR, Party Name, Bill No, Group Name, Item Name, Shade, Quantity, Del - no Date/Remark), typing autosaves and persists after reload, partial row with ONLY Party Name + Bill No (no item/qty) persists and is NOT treated as blank, stat strip updates (ss-stat-lines / ss-stat-qty / ss-stat-bills), party dropdown populated from party master (3 entries). Regression: /company-balance (cb-grid) and /stock-arrived (sa-grid) still expose Group/Item/Shade/Quantity/Date/Remark headers. Shop Sale writes do not affect dashboard or company-balance (verified by API).

frontend_ui_checks.party_dropdown_source: populated from Party master (dl-party_name had 3 options: CHAUDHARY VASTRALAYA, DARDHA; SRI RAM VASTRALAYA, BHELAHI; TRILOK VASTRALAYA, LAKHORA)

critical_code_review_comments: LineRow / LineRowIn now carry party_name + bill_no on every line-sheet collection (company_sent_rows / company_arrived_rows also expose these keys even though the CB/SA UI omits them via omitColumns). That's fine functionally, but it means an API caller of /line-sheet/company-sent-rows can now set party_name/bill_no with no server validation - consider per-sheet Pydantic guards if that ever matters.

is_blank_line correctly treats a row as non-blank when only party_name or bill_no is filled - good, matches the spec. Shared with company-sent/arrived means those sheets will now also keep rows with just party_name/bill_no even though their UI hides those columns; verify E1 is OK with this shared behaviour.

ShopSale.jsx refreshTotals uses api.lineRows and filters on item OR party_name (line 18). Consistent with is_blank_line (party_name+bill_no non-blank), so a bill-only row (no party) is currently NOT counted in ss-stat-lines because the filter requires item OR party_name. Not required by spec but worth aligning with the persistence rule.

LineSheet.jsx line 48 blankRow does NOT default group to '' when omitColumns includes group - Shop Sale still defaults to 'SH ROLL' in blankRow. Since group is not omitted, empty rows show 'SH ROLL' in Group Name (visible in screenshot). E1 may want blankRow.group = '' for Shop Sale to avoid confusing default text on empty rows.
